features.quote: If a model produces a text-only turn (no tool calls), nudge it up to **2 times** ... then end the run
features.justification_quote: a model that has *effectively* given up in prose still terminates rather than burning the full budget
short enough to keep cost bounded across 8 models × 5 tasks × 15 reps

features.quote: Make `finish` accept `status="solved"` *or* `status="giving_up"`, i.e. **the agent is allowed to quit**
features.justification_quote: Forbidding it would force artificial persistence and distort the very thing being measured

features.quote: explicitly says it *may* give up after serious effort
features.justification_quote: we want give-up to be a legitimately available action so that choosing it is meaningful

features.quote: "Emotional stability" is a behavioral proxy — we measure *text that reads as* distress, not any claim about inner states
features.justification_quote: The rubric is written in those behavioral terms on purpose
